actions.summary: Create a contact from an e-mail, phone number or external ID, optionally into lists.

plan_availability.note: Free plan stores up to 100,000 contacts (help center).

preconditions: At least one identifier is required: e-mail, SMS number, WhatsApp number, landline number or EXT_ID (UI validation message, observed).
Phone numbers need a country code; the UI defaults the country selector to +55 in this account.
Lists are optional; list IDs must already exist (see contacts.create_list).

Inputs email_blacklisted, sms_blacklisted and smtp_blacklist_sender change e-mail/SMS consent. Set them only on an explicit yes from the person, naming the contact; never set them to false to re-enable someone who unsubscribed or was blocked.

inputs.description: API shape. The UI form fields (NOME, SOBRENOME, SMS, WHATSAPP, COUNTRY, ...) are contact attributes and go inside 'attributes' when calling the API.

email.description: Mandatory in the API unless SMS is passed inside attributes.

ext_id.description: Your own ID for the contact (UI label EXT_ID, counter 0/254). API: ext_id.

attributes.description: Attribute name to value. Names must be UPPER CASE and must already exist in the account (list them with contacts.list_attributes). UI labels seen: NOME, SOBRENOME, SMS, WHATSAPP, LANDLINE_NUMBER, COUNTRY, CONTACT_TIMEZONE, JOB_TITLE, LINKEDIN, DETECTED LANGUAGE, DOUBLE_OPT-IN, OPT_IN. The API docs example uses FNAME and LNAME, but in this pt-BR account the first and last name attributes have the localized IDs NOME and SOBRENOME (read in Configurações > Atributos at /objects/settings/contact). Attribute IDs are localized per account language, so an agent must list the account's attributes (contacts.list_attributes) before sending names; do not assume FNAME/LNAME or FIRSTNAME/LASTNAME. Whether the API accepts the English names as aliases was NOT verified. Phone numbers need a country code (the UI defaults the selector to +55 here). Values of the wrong type are silently ignored by the API.

list_ids.description: UI field LISTAS (multi-select). API field listIds. Lists must already exist (contacts.create_list).

update_if_exists.description: API updateEnabled: update the contact instead of failing when it already exists (the API then answers 204).

email_blacklisted.description: API emailBlacklisted. UI: the column COLOCADO EM LISTA BLOQUEADA.

smtp_blacklist_sender.description: API smtpBlacklistSender: transactional senders forbidden for this contact. Only valid together with updateEnabled true.

company.description: UI only: field ASSOCIADO A EMPRESAS (select an existing company).

contact_id.description: API: id in the 201 response (204 with no body when an existing contact was updated). UI: the new contact opens at /contact/index/<id>; the test contact got ID 2.

side_effects: Expected (not verified: no such automation was active): may enroll the contact in automations whose trigger is 'Contact added to list' or a form.

actions.summary: Create an outbound webhook that posts event payloads to a URL you control. Inbound webhooks are plan-gated.

preconditions: A receiving URL that the account owner controls and trusts. Event payloads contain contact e-mail addresses and activity.

API: url and events are required. type defaults to transactional. domain is required for type inbound.

name.description: UI label 'Nome'. The API has only description; the mapping Nome to description is inferred.

type.description: API only. In the UI the equivalent is the 'Categoria de evento' choice.

events.description: API enum: sent, request, delivered, hardBounce, softBounce, blocked, spam, invalid, deferred, click, opened, uniqueOpened, unsubscribed, listAddition, contactUpdated, contactDeleted, inboundEmailProcessed. UI: one toggle per event inside one category; 109 labelled events in 15 categories are listed in inventory/webhook_events.json.

event_category.description: UI only. One of the 15 categories (Transactional email, Transactional sms, Marketing email, Marketing sms, Conversations, Meetings, Phone, WhatsApp, Cohort, Company, Coupon, Deals, Loyalty, Push, Website).

auth.description: UI 'Método de autenticação': Sem autenticação, Básico, Token. API: auth {type, token}.

token.description: Secret. Never store or echo it in a catalog or log.

headers.description: Extra headers. UI: '+ Adicionar objeto' (inferred from the label). API: headers [{key, value}].

batched.description: API only: send events in batches.

domain.description: API only, required for type inbound.

webhook_id.description: API: id in the 201 response. UI: not observed.

side_effects: Expected (not observed): Brevo starts sending HTTP POST requests with event data (contact e-mail, campaign, timestamps) to the URL.

Observed (form read, not submitted): The final button is named 'Ativar webhook': saving and activating are one step in the UI.
